title: SkyrimNet Brothel
tagline: Run your own brothel: register workers, send customers to them or take customers yourself, and SkyrimNet's AI voices every offer and answer while SexLab plays the scene.
description:
SkyrimNet Brothel lets you turn any interior into a brothel, and you can run up to three of them at once. You register women as workers (followers or anyone else, or all your female followers at once), or let the brothel hire workers of its own, and customers walk up to them and make paid offers. SkyrimNet's AI writes and voices each offer and the worker's answer, she can accept or refuse, and SexLab plays the scene on a free bed, with double beds chosen first.

You can also take customers yourself and answer them by picking AI-written lines in the dialogue menu, including which position you want. The choice system is built into the mod, so SkyrimNet Player Choices is not needed.

People from the brothel's town can walk over during opening hours and become customers, and you can choose whether customers are men, women or both. You can name yourself or an NPC as the owner, who takes a share of every payment, recommends workers to customers and talks to the workers about their takings. Experienced workers invite customers on their own, workers chat among themselves between customers, and the brothel and every worker gain levels from 1 to 10 that change how they feel about the work.

Customers pay up front and get their gold back if the deal falls through. Everything is set up in an MCM with six pages, and a Manage Brothel power opens a menu with the main settings while you play. The mod requires SexLab P+ (SexLab 1.6x is supported but has not been tested in game), MCM Helper, PapyrusUtil and powerofthree's Papyrus Extender, and UIExtensions is needed only for the Manage Brothel power. A Japanese translation is available as a separate archive.
author: taka
changelog: 0.2.1: Taking customers yourself is much quicker. Your conversation now goes first, so it no longer waits for every worker's offer to end, and no worker, owner or small talk starts talking while you are in it. A needless ten-second wait after your invitation is gone, a customer who accepts your invitation now says yes and asks about the position in one line, and the scene starts as soon as you pick a position. The mod no longer uses TriggerPlayerTTS and IsPlayerTTSFinished, which SkyrimNet beta 29 removes, so it works with beta 28 and beta 29 alike. Pairs no longer sink into the noble single bed, such as Delphine's bed at the Sleeping Giant. 0.2.0: You can run up to three brothels, choose men, women or both as customers, let each brothel hire up to ten workers of its own, register all your female followers at once and run up to twelve pairs at the same time. Workers chat among themselves, a Manage Brothel power opens the main settings, offers are made in many different ways, and two pairs no longer end up on the same bed.
